title: A Golay logical-zero circuit uses 44 two-qubit gates in six layers
summary: An AI-assisted search found a circuit that prepares the logical-zero state of the 23-qubit Golay code with 44 two-qubit gates and two-qubit depth six. The author checked it by stabilizer algebra and full-state simulation. A previously posted 44-gate circuit used seven two-qubit layers under its stated labeling convention.
ai_technology: Claude Sonnet 5.5; Infinity Machine research agent

source_review.scope: Zenodo v1 author's circuit record; Infinity Machine §3.2 and Appendix A.4; earlier QuSynth table and September circuit

evidence.tested: The checks compare the output state with the target up to wire relabeling. The controlled-Z gates are equivalent to CNOTs up to free one-qubit Clifford gates in this comparison.
evidence.unknown: The result assumes unrestricted connectivity and no extra qubits. It does not establish a depth or gate-count optimum, fault-tolerant preparation, or hardware performance.
evidence.ai_role: Claude Sonnet 5.5 wrote a search program and found the circuit starting from a published depth-eight seed supplied by the operator.
